mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, buy_at, total_amount, status, coupon_id) VALUES (#{userId}, CURRENT_DATE, #{totalAmount}, false, #{couponId})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{cart.productId}, #{cart.quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE id IN ( SELECT coupon_id FROM coupons_users WHERE user_id = #{userId} )

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.buy_at, o.total_amount, o.status,
-- ★これが重要（型は絶対壊さない） o.coupon_id,
-- 表示専用（文字列） c.name AS coupon_name
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN coupons c ON o.coupon_id = c.id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.id ASC

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.buy_at, o.total_amount, o.status,
o.coupon_id, c.name AS coupon_name
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN coupons c ON o.coupon_id = c.id
WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.product_id, oi.quantity, p.name, p.price, pi.image_path AS imagePath
FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.id = ( SELECT MIN(id) FROM product_images WHERE product_id = oi.product_id )
WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
